model.provider_comparison_boundary: Same historical model alias and generation parameters; OpenRouter OpenAI route is newly fixed for both arms. No immutable historical backend equivalence claim.

resource_authorization.authorization_boundary: User selected a new complete experimental design. This draft does not authorize changed failure handling or twenty additional paid calls.

api.invalid_output_policy: For an accounted model completion, deterministically invalid whole libraries consume the scheduled slot and map to the same calibration-selected target-only anchor. Preserve the entire response and reasons; continue to the next scheduled slot. Never repair, retain partial strategies, substitute, regenerate, or transfer saved budget.
api.unknown_cost_policy: Stop with unresolved attempt reservation. Prefer finite nonnegative inline cost plus explicit is_byok=false; otherwise bounded GET-only reconciliation. No POST retry.
api.byok_policy: Explicit non-BYOK evidence required; true or unknown stops for billing review.

paired_design.intervention: Replace exact field, value, task and objective labels with reversible randomized codes; preserve numeric evidence, frequencies, legal rule space and maximization direction.
paired_design.generation_sampling: Fresh independent draws at the historical temperature; no model seed was present in the historical request. Adjacent pairs with balanced randomized within-pair arm order.
paired_design.anonymity_boundary: Labels are hidden, but frequencies/structure may reveal task identity. This does not establish pretraining independence.
paired_design.prompt_policy: Reuse the exact v1 common labeled prompt and system/contract. Anonymous messages are changed only by fresh reversible alias permutations. No field-remapping fix or new output-format enforcement.

selection.method: Existing canonical five-fold selector; each library separately selects one of its five strategies.
selection.folds: Sorted calibration seeds assigned index::5; same folds across libraries.
selection.tie_break: Prespecified pair/arm/slot IDs; same slot ordering in each library.
selection.invalid_library_policy: No candidate strategies are extracted or evaluated. Use the shared target-only anchor selected once from calibration data; retain the invalid library as its original assigned arm/pair.

target_anchor.criterion: max existing mode_means composite (mean final_best + mean best_so_far_auc), preserving existing six-decimal rounding and lexical mode tie-break

analysis.primary_estimand: Equal mean labeled-minus-anonymous AUC over all ten newly scheduled generation pairs and one hundred shared heldout starts, including deterministically invalid model completions through a prespecified common fallback.
analysis.resampling: Independently resample paired-library axis and the shared heldout-seed axis; keep labeled/anonymous together in every paired contrast.
analysis.stable_advantage: 95% crossed-bootstrap lower bound > 0 AND mean difference > 0 in each of five consecutive heldout blocks; all ten pair means also reported descriptively.
analysis.missing_cells: All twenty slots must reach VALID or INVALID_ANCHOR_FALLBACK with settled cost and verified provenance. Missing responses or HALT states block any primary analysis; do not discard or impute missing infrastructure outcomes.
analysis.scope: Conditional on known BH pool, model/prompt, invalid-library fallback rule and frozen calibration choices. No pure chemistry mechanism, pretraining independence, unseen dataset generalization, or equivalence claim.
analysis.primary_interpretation: Effect of semantic labels on generation validity plus selected-rule utility in the prespecified workflow, before the efficacy gate for valid banks. Not pure rule-quality or chemical-knowledge causality.
analysis.both_valid_subset_policy: Report pair IDs/count and descriptive raw differences only. No separate confirmatory p-value, significance claim, or generalization to all generations. If empty, report unavailable rather than zero.
analysis.degenerate_bootstrap: If all ten pairs fall back on both arms, AUC differences and bootstrap interval are exactly zero by policy construction; report no generated valid rules and do not interpret this as equivalence or precise knowledge estimation.

before_content_classification: verified provider/model and HTTP response provenance
exact scheduled request and source/input hashes
pair material equals pinned deterministic build
invalid_cases: empty or absent model content with an otherwise valid completion envelope
strict JSON/whole-library contract violation including source-only field, illegal field/value, count, key, numeric bounds, IDs or text length
halt_cases: HTTP or transport errors including provider-level safety errors without a normal accounted completion envelope
malformed completion envelope or unexpected number of choices
unknown cost, BYOK, budget or rate limit issues
